name: Audit log
summary: Every post, reply and comment goes in the audit log right after it goes out, then gets checked live.

nodes.title: Something went out
nodes.sub: A post, reply, comment, article or video
nodes.body: Log it before the next send.

nodes.title: Look things up
nodes.body:
- `python playbook/audit.py today`: what went out today, against the caps.
- `python playbook/audit.py gap --platform X --account @acmenotes_demo --action reply`: READY or WAIT.
- `python playbook/audit.py search <words>`: was this said before?

nodes.title: Logged and verified
nodes.sub: The History panel on the canvas shows it
